name: Block v2 + Coinbase Height
summary: BIP-34 requires the block height to be included in the coinbase transaction, preventing duplicate coinbase transactions across different blocks. This also introduced block version 2.
summaryZh: BIP-34 要求在 coinbase 交易中包含区块高度，防止不同区块之间出现重复的 coinbase 交易。同时引入了区块版本2。
